name: starryear-threefold-memory
title_zh: 把一张照片变成上中下三段式记忆圣物
tagline_zh: 照片会骗人，记忆会碎。它把碎片拼成视觉拼贴、保留原图作证、再画一张空间信号图，让「看见的、发生的、留下的」各归其位。
tagline_en: Photos lie, memory shatters. This turns one shot into a triptych: fragmented collage above, untouched evidence.
desc_en: Transform one user-supplied photograph into a vertical three-panel memory artwork: a large fragmented visual-memory collage above, unchanged photographic evidence in the middle, and a source-specific spatial signal map below. Use for Threefold Memory, What I Saw / What Happened / What Stayed, 三段式记忆, or photo-to-memory triptychs. The method adapts every route, node, fragment, pictogram, palette, an
why_zh: 不是滤镜，是结构。它把「记忆」拆成三层独立证据链，每层用不同视觉语法（拼贴/原图/信号图）说话。
why_en: Not a filter—a structure. It splits memory into three independent evidence layers, each speaking a different visual grammar.
limit_zh: 只吃单张用户照片，且必须能识别出空间路线或节点；否则信号图会退化成随机噪点。产物是竖版三拼图，不导出分层文件。
limit_en: Single photo only, must contain recognizable spatial routes/nodes or the signal map degrades to noise. Output is a vertical triptych—no layered.
